Following a series of fires since July 20, Tipperary County Council has requested aerial support to dampen remaining hotspots on Slievenamon. No threat to life or property is currently reported.

Even with aerial support, the underlying climate conditions and vegetation types make the area prone to recurring fires.

The Unavoidable Truth: Hotspots can remain active beneath the surface for days.

The Unavoidable Lie: The fire is completely extinguished without further monitoring.
